title: Resilient education systems require resilient financing
discussion_signal: The post links sustained education progress to financing benchmarks and argues that equity must remain central under fiscal pressure. A reaction proposes measuring community contribution and value, providing a counter-signal about alternative financing narratives while also showing the risk of shifting public responsibility onto communities.
linked_research_question: How do financing choices and fiscal pressure shape equitable access to education and public-system resilience?
limits: Institutional post and one self-selected reaction
The post does not provide country-level financing analysis
The reaction’s proposed metric is not an evaluated intervention
